verdict.rationale: Gram documents team/server/tool-level RBAC enforced with OAuth2.1 synced to enterprise IDPs, and explicitly blocks unsanctioned shadow MCP servers by default, directly matching allowlist/per-tool access control for a platform-engineer persona. This is corroborated by third-party rollout evidence (MoonPay) and governance guides for wrapping third-party MCP servers with access control. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the RBAC/permission enforcement mechanics beyond vendor docs and GitHub README claims.
